pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with softened, non-linear edges. Geometries vary from subtriangular to complex multi-sided forms with low-contrast pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh with frequent tri-radiate and quadri-radiate nodes. Pathway width remains relatively constant across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, erect mane along the neck-shoulder axis exhibiting a fine, high-frequency serrated silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple avian organisms (Oxpeckers) are perched along the upper dorsal ridge and right-side neck, creating localized textural and color contrasts against the pelage.
